items.title: Cocoa And Spice Valley Day
items.text: Follow cocoa from tree to drying rack and meet growers along the Sambirano river.

items.title: Sail The Bay Of Ramena
items.text: A morning on the water with swimming stops in the Emerald Sea.

items.title: Ankify To Nosy Be Crossing
items.text: A scenic drive and a speedboat crossing, with lunch by the water.

items.title: Nosy Iranja Sandbar Day
items.text: Walk the white sandbar, snorkel with turtles and climb to the lighthouse.

items.title: Antananarivo And Ambohimanga
items.text: The old town, the Rova and the sacred royal hill north of the capital.

items.title: Baobab Avenue At Sunset
items.text: Arrive before the crowds and watch the light turn the trunks orange.

items.title: Manongarivo Forest Trek
items.text: Guided trails through a protected reserve, with optional camping.

items.title: Andasibe Indri And Night Walk
items.text: Track the indri at dawn and spot nocturnal lemurs after dark.

steps.title: Hotel pick-up
steps.text: Your driver and guide collect you in the morning.

steps.title: Guided visit
steps.text: Unhurried stops, with time for photos and questions.

steps.title: Lunch with locals
steps.text: A simple meal in a village or by the water.

steps.title: Back by late afternoon
steps.text: Dropped at your hotel in time to rest.
